strategy.overview: Hoopin' It Up plays as two timed basketball halves. Green teammate scoops pass the ball and can remove defenders from scoring lanes; then shoot an open 2-point, 3-point, or dunk lane before the shot clock or a turnover resets the possession. Halftime minigames can earn time for overtime.
strategy.simpleOverview: Hit green teammate scoops to open a scoring lane, then shoot the available 2-point, 3-point, or dunk shot before the possession resets. At halftime, choose a minigame to earn overtime time.
strategy.summary: Pass through green teammate scoops until a scoring lane opens, then make the labeled 2-point, 3-point, or dunk shot before a turnover or shot-clock violation. Use the halftime minigame to build overtime time.

quickInfo.name: Pass
quickInfo.summary: Green scoops represent teammates. Hitting one can remove a defender and make a scoring lane available.

quickInfo.name: Open shot
quickInfo.summary: Shoot a lane labeled 2 points, 3 points, or dunk after it becomes available.

quickInfo.name: Possession
quickInfo.summary: A turnover or shot-clock violation clears the current passing progress and starts another possession.

quickInfo.name: Halftime
quickInfo.summary: Choose a short minigame between the two halves; its result contributes time to overtime.

steps.text: Before launch, use the flippers to select a topic on the rules whiteboard and press launch to read any unfamiliar rule.
At the start of a possession, hit a green teammate scoop to pass and remove a blocker from a scoring lane.
When a lane shows an open 2-point, 3-point, or dunk opportunity, shoot it before the shot clock expires.
After a turnover, missed possession, or made basket resets the floor, pass again to create the next open shot.
At halftime, choose and play a minigame. Return to the second half, then use the earned overtime time after regulation.
Use rebounds, assists, and free throws when their labels appear, but keep the open field-goal lane as the repeatable route.
Avoid red defender scoops and complete the current shot before the shot clock reaches zero.
Convert the halftime minigame into overtime time, then repeat the pass-and-shoot sequence.
